model_spec.name: Gemini 4 Argon
model_spec.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's frontier model for complex workflows across software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity defense, with a unified 1M token context window and tunable thinking.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
model_spec.description: Gemini 3.6 Flash, the successor to Gemini 3.5 Flash, is a high speed, high value thinking model with 1M context, designed for agentic workflows, multi-turn chat, and coding assistance. It delivers near Pro level reasoning with substantially lower latency.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
model_spec.description: Gemini 3.7 Flash, the successor to Gemini 3.6 Flash, is built for complex coding, agentic workflows, and reliable multi-step execution, with 1M context and tunable thinking.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
model_spec.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash, the successor to Gemini 3.7 Flash, is built for complex coding, agentic workflows, and reliable multi-step execution, with 1M context and tunable thinking.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
model_spec.description: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is the fastest, most cost-efficient Gemini 3.5 model with 1M context, ideal for everyday questions, summarization, and lightweight coding tasks.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.3
model_spec.description: GLM-5.3 is a large-scale reasoning model from Z.ai, built for complex software engineering and long-horizon agent tasks. It supports text input and output with a 1M-token context window, and improves on GLM-5.2 in coding and in the balance between performance and token efficiency.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
model_spec.description: GLM-5.3 Flash is a reasoning model designed for coding, sustained agentic work, and production workloads. It is suited for long-horizon software engineering, complex reasoning, and workflows that combine text with visual context.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.2
model_spec.description: GLM-5.2, the successor to GLM-5.1, is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring significantly enhanced reasoning capabilities, improved instruction following, and support for multiple languages. Supports a longer context window than GLM-5.1 for processing extensive text and detailed analysis with fast inference speed.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.1
model_spec.description: GLM-5.1, the successor to GLM-5, is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring significantly enhanced reasoning capabilities, improved instruction following, and support for multiple languages. Supports large context windows for processing extensive text and detailed analysis with fast inference speed.

model_spec.name: GLM 5
model_spec.description: GLM-5, the successor to GLM-4.7, is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring significantly enhanced reasoning capabilities, improved instruction following, and support for multiple languages. Supports large context windows for processing extensive text and detailed analysis.

model_spec.name: GLM 5 Turbo
model_spec.description: GLM-5 Turbo is a fast inference model from Z.ai tuned for strong performance in agent-driven environments and production coding workflows.

model_spec.name: GLM 5V Turbo
model_spec.description: GLM-5V-Turbo is Z.ai's first native multimodal agent foundation model, built for vision-based coding and agent-driven tasks with image and text inputs.

model_spec.name: GLM 4.7 Flash Heretic
model_spec.description: GLM-4.7-Flash-Heretic is an uncensored experimental variant of GLM-4.7-Flash, optimized for creative freedom and unfiltered dialogue with fast inference speed.

model_spec.name: GLM 4.6
model_spec.description: GLM-4.6 is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring strong reasoning capabilities and support for multiple languages. Supports a large context window for processing extensive text and detailed analysis.

model_spec.name: GLM 4.7
model_spec.description: GLM-4.7, the successor to GLM-4.6, is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring strong reasoning capabilities and support for multiple languages. Supports a large context window for processing extensive text and detailed analysis.

model_spec.name: Venice Uncensored 1.2
model_spec.description: Venice Uncensored 1.2 is designed for maximum creative freedom and authentic interaction. Built for open-ended exploration, roleplay, and unfiltered dialogue with improved capabilities over 1.1.

model_spec.name: Venice Role Play Uncensored
model_spec.description: Optimized for creative roleplay scenarios with maximum freedom. Designed for immersive storytelling, character interactions, and open-ended creative writing.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.8 2.4T
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.8 2.4T is Alibaba's open-weight 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE model (95B active), with major gains in software engineering, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. It is text-only, requires thinking mode, and supports a 262K-token context window.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.8 Max
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.8 Max is Alibaba's flagship 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE model, with major gains over Qwen 3.7 Max in software engineering and office-productivity workflows and strong long-horizon, multi-agent performance. It accepts both text and vision-language input (images and video), operates in thinking mode only, and supports a 1M-token context window.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.8 27B is a native vision-language dense model with 27B parameters. It improves coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with flexible thinking control and image and video understanding. It supports a native 262K-token context window.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.8 Flash
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.8 Flash is a multimodal model in the Qwen family, pairing strong reasoning and generation with remarkable speed. It natively supports a 1M-token context window, so it can process long documents, entire codebases, and complex conversations in a single pass. It excels at coding assistance, agentic workflows, and visual understanding, accepting text, image, and video input, and its thinking mode can be turned on or off per request.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.7 Max
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.7 Max is the largest model in the Qwen 3.7 series, with deep thinking, function calling, prompt caching, and multimodal input support for images and video. It excels at programming, office and productivity tasks, and long-running autonomous agent workflows.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.7 Plus
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.7 Plus, the successor to Qwen 3.6 Plus, is a reasoning model from Alibaba with exceptional performance across coding, reasoning, and general knowledge tasks. Features mixed reasoning, function calling, and multimodal input support.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.6 Plus Uncensored is an uncensored variant of Alibaba's Qwen 3.6 Plus, a reasoning model with exceptional performance across coding, reasoning, and general knowledge tasks. Features mixed reasoning, function calling, and multimodal input support.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.6 27B
model_spec.description: The Qwen 3.6 27B native vision-language dense model builds upon the 3.5-27B version, with key improvements in agentic coding capabilities and enhanced STEM reasoning and inference skills. In the vision modality, it demonstrates significant advances in spatial intelligence, object localization, and detection, while video understanding, document OCR, and visual agent capabilities continue to improve steadily.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B is a fast mixture-of-experts model with 35B total parameters and ~3B active per token. Strong at agentic coding, STEM reasoning, and tool use, with a native 256K context window.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.5 397B
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.5 is a reasoning model from Alibaba featuring a 397B parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 17B active parameters. It excels at complex reasoning, coding, and general knowledge tasks.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.5 35B A3B
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.5 35B A3B is a highly efficient MoE model with 35B total parameters and only 3B active parameters. It surpasses the larger Qwen3-235B-A22B while being 6.7x smaller, excelling at reasoning, coding, and general knowledge tasks.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3 235B A22B Thinking 2507
model_spec.description: Reasons step by step before it answers. Built for in-depth research and handling long, complex documents. Ideal for technical work and high-precision tasks.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3 235B A22B Instruct 2507
model_spec.description: Answers directly, without a reasoning step. Built for in-depth research and handling long, complex documents. Ideal for technical work and high-precision tasks.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3 Next 80b
model_spec.description: Optimized for speed and efficiency.

model_spec.name: Qwen3 VL 235B
model_spec.description: Qwen3-VL 235B vision-language model with MoE architecture. The largest model in the Qwen3-VL series, with superior visual perception, OCR, and multimodal reasoning.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3 Coder 480B Turbo
model_spec.description: Turbo variant of Qwen3 Coder 480B, optimized for faster inference on code tasks.

model_spec.name: Google Gemma 4 26B A4B Instruct
model_spec.description: Gemma 4 26B A4B is a Mixture-of-Experts model from Google DeepMind with 26B total parameters and only 4B active per token, offering fast inference at high quality. It handles text, image, and video input, supports 256K context, function calling, and reasoning with configurable thinking modes.

model_spec.name: Google Gemma 4 31B Instruct
model_spec.description: Gemma 4 31B is a dense model from Google DeepMind with 31B parameters, delivering frontier-level reasoning performance. It handles text, image, and video input, supports 256K context, function calling, and configurable thinking modes.

model_spec.name: Gemma 4 Uncensored
model_spec.description: Gemma 4 Uncensored is an uncensored variant of Google Gemma 4 26B, a Mixture-of-Experts model with 26B total parameters and only 4B active per token. Fine-tuned for uncensored chat without content filtering, it supports 256K context, coding, and general-purpose conversation.

model_spec.name: Google Gemma 3 27B Instruct
model_spec.description: Gemma 3 introduces multimodality, supporting vision-language input and text outputs. It handles context windows up to 128k tokens, understands over 140 languages, and offers improved math, reasoning, and chat capabilities, including structured outputs and function calling. Gemma 3 27B is Google's open source model, successor to Gemma 2.

model_spec.name: Grok 4.3
model_spec.description: Grok 4.3 is a reasoning model from xAI with function calling, structured outputs, and a 1M-token context window. Suited for agentic workflows, instruction-following tasks, and applications requiring high factual accuracy.

model_spec.name: Grok 4.5
model_spec.description: Grok 4.5 is xAI's intelligent coding model for agentic software engineering and workflow tasks, with function calling, structured outputs, and a 500K-token context window.

model_spec.name: Grok 4.6
model_spec.description: Grok 4.6 is xAI's multimodal chat and reasoning model with function calling, structured outputs, adjustable reasoning effort (low/medium/high/xhigh), and a 500K-token context window.

model_spec.name: Grok 4.7
model_spec.description: Grok 4.7, the successor to Grok 4.6, is xAI's multimodal chat and reasoning model with function calling, structured outputs, adjustable reasoning effort (low/medium/high/xhigh), and a 500K-token context window.

model_spec.name: Grok 4.20
model_spec.description: Grok 4.20 is xAI's multimodal reasoning model with strong tool use, structured output support, and a 2M-token context window.

model_spec.name: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent
model_spec.description: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent is a variant of xAI Grok 4.20 designed for collaborative, agent-based workflows. Multiple agents operate in parallel to conduct deep research, coordinate tool use, and synthesize information across complex tasks.

model_spec.name: Grok Build 0.1
model_spec.description: xAI's fast coding model trained specifically for agentic coding, currently in early access.

model_spec.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct
model_spec.description: Mistral Small 3.2 is a 24B parameter model optimized for efficiency and performance. Ideal for general-purpose tasks with balanced speed and capability.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
model_spec.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro is an evolution of Google's flagship frontier model with 1M context, advancing high-precision multimodal reasoning across text, image, and code.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
model_spec.description: Gemini 3.5 Flash is a high speed, high value thinking model with 1M context, designed for agentic workflows, multi-turn chat, and coding assistance. It delivers near Pro level reasoning with substantially lower latency.

model_spec.name: Gemini 3 Flash Preview
model_spec.description: Gemini 3 Flash Preview is a high speed, high value thinking model designed for agentic workflows, multi-turn chat, and coding assistance. It delivers near Pro level reasoning with substantially lower latency.

model_spec.name: Claude Fable 5
model_spec.description: Claude Fable 5 is a model from Anthropic designed for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, always-on adaptive thinking, and strong multimodal capabilities.

model_spec.name: Claude Fable 5.1
model_spec.description: Claude Fable 5.1 improves on Claude Fable 5 across the board, with the biggest gains in agentic coding, long-running agentic workflows, and knowledge work such as long code refactors, front-end development, and finance and analysis tasks. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, always-on adaptive thinking, and strong multimodal capabilities, and tends to be more concise in its plans and summaries.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 5
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 5, the successor to Opus 4.8, delivers major gains in agentic coding, professional knowledge work, and long-horizon reasoning, with a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong multimodal capabilities.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 5 Fast
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 5 (Fast) is a speed-optimized variant of Claude Opus 5, offering the same 1M token context window and strong performance across agentic coding, professional knowledge work, and long-horizon reasoning — with lower latency.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 5.5
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 5.5 is a step-change improvement over Opus 5, with the biggest gains in agentic coding, long-running agentic tasks, and knowledge work. It is also a much better collaborator on long-running work, with a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong multimodal capabilities.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 5.5 Fast
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 5.5 Fast serves the same Opus 5.5 model with faster output generation, a 1M token context window, up to 128K output tokens, adaptive thinking, vision, and tool calling.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 4.8
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 4.8 is the successor to Opus 4.7 in Anthropic's Opus family. It supports long-horizon agentic work, complex multi-step coding, and memory-driven tasks where coherence over extended sessions matters. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong multimodal capabilities.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 4.8 Fast
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 4.8 (Fast) is a speed-optimized variant of Claude Opus 4.8, offering the same 1M token context window and strong performance across long-horizon agentic work and complex coding — with lower latency.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 4.7
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 4.7 is a model from Anthropic for complex reasoning and agentic coding. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong multimodal capabilities.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 4.6
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 4.6 is a reasoning model from Anthropic, building on Opus 4.5 with enhanced performance across complex software engineering, agentic workflows, and long-horizon tasks. It features a 1M token context window, improved multimodal capabilities, and stronger robustness to prompt injection.

model_spec.name: Claude Opus 4.5
model_spec.description: Claude Opus 4.5 is Anthropic's frontier reasoning model optimized for complex software engineering, agentic workflows, and long-horizon computer use. It offers strong multimodal capabilities, competitive performance across real-world coding and reasoning benchmarks, and improved robustness to prompt injection.

model_spec.name: Claude Sonnet 5
model_spec.description: Claude Sonnet 5 follows Sonnet 4.6, substantially improving on it in coding and agentic work and reaching near-Opus quality on many tasks. It features a 1M token context window, adaptive thinking, and strong document and vision understanding.

model_spec.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
model_spec.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is a step-change improvement over Sonnet 5. It performs great with well-scoped everyday tasks like building features, fixing bugs, and creating polished documents, slides, and spreadsheets. Sonnet 5.5 also improves on communication and writes more clearly than Sonnet 5. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong document and vision understanding.

model_spec.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
model_spec.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is built for high-volume, latency-sensitive work such as classification, routing, extraction, and subagent tasks. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong document and vision understanding.

model_spec.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
model_spec.description: Claude Sonnet 4.6 is Anthropic's best combination of speed and intelligence, offering strong performance on coding, reasoning, and general tasks with excellent speed and cost efficiency. It features a 1M token context window and 64K max output tokens.

model_spec.name: OpenAI GPT OSS 120B
model_spec.description: gpt-oss-120b is an open-weight, 117B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model from OpenAI designed for high-reasoning, agentic, and general-purpose production use cases. The model supports configurable reasoning depth, full chain-of-thought access, and native tool use, including function calling, browsing, and structured output generation

model_spec.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
model_spec.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot AI's flagship multimodal reasoning model and the post-trained successor to Kimi K3, with a 1M-token context window. It is built for long-horizon coding, agentic workflows, financial research, and 3D modeling through CAD code.

model_spec.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed
model_spec.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed is the faster variant of Kimi K3.1 Pro, Moonshot AI's flagship multimodal reasoning model. It offers the same quality and 1M-token context window with substantially higher output speed for latency-sensitive coding and agentic workflows.

model_spec.name: Kimi K3
model_spec.description: Kimi K3 is an ultra-large-scale, open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Moonshot AI. It is suited for complex coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon agentic workflows, and is particularly strong at navigating large repositories, using tools, debugging, and iterating against images, logs, tests, and runtime feedback.

model_spec.name: Kimi K3 Fast
model_spec.description: Kimi K3 is an ultra-large-scale, open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Moonshot AI. It is suited for complex coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon agentic workflows, and is particularly strong at navigating large repositories, using tools, debugging, and iterating against images, logs, tests, and runtime feedback.

model_spec.name: Kimi K2.7 Code
model_spec.description: Kimi K2.7 Code is Moonshot AI's coding-focused agentic model built on Kimi K2.6, with 1T total parameters and 32B active parameters. It always operates in thinking mode, supports text and image input, and targets long-horizon software engineering, agentic task decomposition, and multi-turn coding workflows with 256K context.

model_spec.name: Kimi K2.6
model_spec.description: Kimi K2.6 is an open-source, native multimodal agentic model from Moonshot AI with 1T total parameters and 32B active parameters. It excels at long-horizon coding, coding-driven design, agent swarm orchestration, and proactive autonomous execution with a 256K-token context window.

model_spec.name: Kimi K2.5
model_spec.description: Kimi K2.5 is an open reasoning model from Moonshot AI, featuring trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 32B active parameters and a 256K-token context window.

model_spec.name: MiMo-V2.5
model_spec.description: MiMo-V2.5 is Xiaomi's native omnimodal model with strong agentic capabilities, supporting text, image, video, and audio understanding in a unified architecture. Built on a sparse Mixture-of-Experts backbone with 310B total and 15B active parameters, it delivers long-context reasoning up to 1M tokens, function calling, and multimodal perception.

model_spec.name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash
model_spec.description: MiMo-V2.6-Flash is Xiaomi's efficiency-balanced omnimodal model: a sparse Mixture-of-Experts with 309B total and 15B activated parameters, natively understanding text, image, video, and audio with a 1M-token context window. Trained with mixed reinforcement learning across coding, general agents, visual, and cybersecurity tasks, it is built for long-horizon coding, tool use, and computer use.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro is a 1.6T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 49B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Built for advanced reasoning, coding, and long-horizon agentic workflows with a hybrid attention system for efficient long-context processing.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash is an efficiency-optimized 284B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 13B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Tuned for fast inference and high-throughput workloads while maintaining strong reasoning and coding performance.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 follows the 0423 release of DeepSeek V4 Flash, an efficiency-optimized 284B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 13B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Tuned for fast inference and high-throughput workloads while maintaining strong reasoning and coding performance.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash (1017)
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored is an abliterated, uncensored variant of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance and no content-filtering guardrails.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Uncensored
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Uncensored is an abliterated, uncensored variant of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance and no content-filtering guardrails.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Ultrafast
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V3.2
model_spec.description: DeepSeek-V3.2 is an efficient large language model with DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for long contexts. It features strong reasoning and tool-use skills, achieving top results on the 2025 IMO and IOI.

model_spec.name: Seed 2.1 Turbo
model_spec.description: Seed 2.1 Turbo (Dola-Seed-2.1) is ByteDance’s next-generation multimodal model for the coding and agent era, with engineering-grade code delivery, long-horizon agent execution, and upgraded GUI and video understanding. Supports text, image, and video inputs with a 256K context window.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro is a 1.6T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 49B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Built for advanced reasoning, coding, and long-horizon agentic workflows with a hybrid attention system for efficient long-context processing.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Fast
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 follows the 0423 release of DeepSeek V4 Flash, an efficiency-optimized 284B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 13B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Tuned for fast inference and high-throughput workloads while maintaining strong reasoning and coding performance.

model_spec.name: Aion 3.0
model_spec.description: Aion 3.0 is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the GLM family of models. Multiple specialized models collaborate on each response to produce stronger narrative structure and more compelling tension and conflict. It handles mature and darker themes with nuance and supports tool calling for richer interactive fiction.

model_spec.name: Aion 3.0 Mini
model_spec.description: Aion 3.0 Mini is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the DeepSeek family of models. Multiple specialized models collaborate on each response to produce stronger narrative structure and more compelling tension and conflict at lower cost. It handles mature and darker themes with nuance and supports tool calling for richer interactive fiction.

model_spec.name: Aion 3.5
model_spec.description: Aion 3.5, the successor to Aion 3.0, is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the GLM family of models, with a longer context window. Multiple specialized models collaborate on each response to produce stronger narrative structure and more compelling tension and conflict. It handles mature and darker themes with nuance and supports tool calling for richer interactive fiction.

model_spec.name: Aion 3.5 Mini
model_spec.description: Aion 3.5 Mini is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the GLM family of models. Multiple specialized models collaborate on each response to produce stronger narrative structure and more compelling tension and conflict at lower cost. It handles mature and darker themes with nuance and supports tool calling for richer interactive fiction.

model_spec.name: Abliterated Large V2
model_spec.description: Abliterated Large V2 is Abliteration AI's unrestricted reasoning model, based on GLM-5.3 and further abliterated and fine-tuned. Text-only with 1M context, for harder reasoning and evaluation workloads. Always reasons; depth can be set to low, high, or max.

model_spec.name: Abliterated Large Flash
model_spec.description: Abliterated Large Flash is Abliteration AI's unrestricted multimodal model, based on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and further abliterated. It has 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance and no content-filtering guardrails.

model_spec.name: Muse Wonder
model_spec.description: Muse Wonder is a frontier reasoning model from Meta for complex personal and professional agentic tasks. It accepts text, images, video, audio, and PDF documents and returns text, with a 1M-token context window. The model plans, delegates to sub-agents, calls tools in parallel, and recovers from errors so long-horizon work can run to completion without step-by-step direction.

model_spec.name: Muse Spark Open
model_spec.description: Muse Spark Open is an open-weight reasoning model from Meta for coding and agentic workflows. It supports tool calling and native image understanding in a single checkpoint, using a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 816B total / 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context window.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.2
model_spec.description: GPT-5.2 is a frontier-grade model in the GPT-5 series, offering stronger agentic and long context performance compared to GPT-5.1. It uses adaptive reasoning to allocate computation dynamically, responding quickly to simple queries while spending more depth on complex tasks.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.3 Codex
model_spec.description: GPT-5.3 Codex, the successor to GPT-5.2 Codex, is OpenAI's specialized coding model, optimized for advanced software development, code generation, and technical problem-solving. It supports a longer context window and longer outputs than GPT-5.2 Codex.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.4
model_spec.description: GPT-5.4, the successor to GPT-5.2, is a frontier model in the GPT-5 series with a 1M+ context window, offering improved agentic and long context performance. It uses adaptive reasoning to dynamically allocate computation across tasks.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.4 Pro
model_spec.description: GPT-5.4 Pro builds on GPT-5.4's unified architecture with enhanced reasoning for complex, high-stakes tasks. It provides a 1M+ token context window (922K input, 128K output) and supports text and image inputs.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.4 Mini
model_spec.description: GPT-5.4 Mini brings the core capabilities of GPT-5.4 to a faster, more efficient model optimized for high-throughput workloads. It supports text and image inputs with strong performance across reasoning, coding, and tool use.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.5
model_spec.description: GPT-5.5, the successor to GPT-5.4, is a frontier model in the GPT-5 series with a 1M+ context window, offering improved agentic and long context performance. It uses adaptive reasoning to dynamically allocate computation across tasks.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.5 Pro
model_spec.description: GPT-5.5 Pro, the successor to GPT-5.4 Pro, builds on GPT-5.5's unified architecture with enhanced reasoning for complex, high-stakes tasks. It provides a 1M+ token context window (922K input, 128K output) and supports text and image inputs.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
model_spec.description: GPT-5.6 Luna is a fast, cost-efficient model in OpenAI's GPT-5.6 series. It is suited for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as chat, classification, and lightweight agentic workflows, providing capable reasoning for its price tier.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.6 Luna Pro
model_spec.description: GPT-5.6 Luna Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-5.6 Luna, served with reasoning.mode set to pro for higher-quality responses on complex tasks.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
model_spec.description: GPT-5.6 Terra is a balanced model in OpenAI's GPT-5.6 series, positioned between the flagship Sol tier and the cost-efficient Luna tier. It is suited for everyday coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks where capability and cost need to be balanced.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.6 Terra Pro
model_spec.description: GPT-5.6 Terra Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-5.6 Terra, served with reasoning.mode set to pro for higher-quality responses on complex tasks.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
model_spec.description: GPT-5.6 Sol is the flagship model in OpenAI's GPT-5.6 series. It is suited for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows, and is particularly strong at command-line and multi-step coding tasks and long-horizon problem solving.

model_spec.name: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro
model_spec.description: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-5.6 Sol, served with reasoning.mode set to pro for higher-quality responses on complex tasks.

model_spec.name: GPT-6 Astra
model_spec.description: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's most capable model, built for the hardest end-to-end work. It is suited for complex reasoning, coding, computer use, research, and document creation, with a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output) and support for text and image inputs.

model_spec.name: GPT-6 Astra Pro
model_spec.description: GPT-6 Astra with pro reasoning mode for difficult tasks that benefit from more model work. Supports text and image inputs with a 1.05M token context window. Pro mode can use more tokens and take longer than standard Astra.

model_spec.name: GPT-6 Luna
model_spec.description: GPT-6 Luna is OpenAI's most efficient GPT-6 model for focused, high-volume tasks. It is suited for chat, classification, and lightweight agentic workflows, with a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output), text and image inputs, and capable reasoning for its price tier.

model_spec.name: GPT-6 Sol
model_spec.description: GPT-6 Sol is built for complex coding and agentic workflows. It is OpenAI's GPT-6 coding and agent model, with a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output), support for text and image inputs, and reasoning effort from none through max.

model_spec.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
model_spec.description: GPT-6.1 Sol delivers near-Astra performance at a lower cost for complex coding, computer use, and professional work. It has a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output), support for text and image inputs, and reasoning effort from low through max.

model_spec.name: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast
model_spec.description: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast is the same model served in OpenAI's Ultrafast mode, up to 8x faster. It has a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output), support for text and image inputs, and reasoning effort from low through max.

model_spec.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
model_spec.description: GPT-6.1 Terra is a fast, efficient model for visual reasoning, precise computer use, and clear, natural writing. It has a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output), support for text and image inputs, and reasoning effort from none through max.

model_spec.name: GPT-4o
model_spec.description: OpenAI's multimodal model with vision capabilities, strong reasoning, and broad knowledge. Popular for its balanced performance across tasks. Version: 2024-11-20.

model_spec.name: GPT-4o Mini
model_spec.description: OpenAI's cost-efficient small model that delivers GPT-4 level intelligence at a fraction of the cost. Ideal for high-volume applications requiring strong reasoning. Version: 2024-07-18.

model_spec.name: MiniMax M3 Preview
model_spec.description: MiniMax-M3 preview is a 1.4T-parameter frontier model from MiniMax for coding, agentic workflows, and complex reasoning, served at fp8 with a 512K context window.

model_spec.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
model_spec.description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a frontier model for coding, agentic workflows, and complex reasoning, with a 1M-token context window, text, image, and video input, and tunable thinking depth from low to max (max by default).

model_spec.name: MiniMax M2.5
model_spec.description: MiniMax-M2.5 is a large language model optimized for coding, agentic workflows, and modern application development with enhanced reasoning capabilities.

model_spec.name: MiniMax M2.7
model_spec.description: MiniMax-M2.7 is a large language model designed for autonomous, real-world productivity with advanced agentic capabilities through multi-agent collaboration.

model_spec.name: Mercury 2
model_spec.description: Mercury 2 is a diffusion-based reasoning LLM from Inception, delivering over 1,000 tokens per second — 5x faster than leading speed-optimized models — with strong reasoning, tool use, and structured output capabilities.

model_spec.name: Mercury 2.5
model_spec.description: Mercury 2.5 is a diffusion-based reasoning model from Inception with fast parallel token generation, tunable reasoning, tool calling, and structured output support.

model_spec.name: Mercury 3
model_spec.description: Mercury 3 is Inception's most capable diffusion-based reasoning model, generating over 1,000 tokens per second with a 1M-token context window, tunable reasoning, tool calling, and structured output support.

model_spec.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B
model_spec.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B is a compact and efficient language model from NVIDIA, optimized for fast inference while maintaining strong performance across diverse tasks.

model_spec.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B
model_spec.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal vision-language model for specialized agents. Its 120B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts design (12B active) understands text, images, documents, GUIs, and video, combining reasoning, instruction following, and tool use for long-running agentic workflows.

model_spec.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
model_spec.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is built for frontier reasoning, orchestration, coding agents, deep research, and complex enterprise workflows. It delivers up to 5x faster inference and up to 30% lower cost for agentic workloads.

model_spec.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored
model_spec.description: Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). An uncensored variant of Google's Gemma 4 MoE model with 25.2B total / 3.8B active parameters, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.2
model_spec.description: GLM 5.2 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A Z.AI model for long-horizon tasks with enhanced reasoning and project-level engineering context, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.3
model_spec.description: GLM 5.3 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Z.ai's flagship model with 1M context. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: GPT OSS 120B
model_spec.description: GPT OSS 120B running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). OpenAI's open-weight 117B-parameter MoE model with configurable reasoning depth and native tool use, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

model_spec.name: Kimi K3
model_spec.description: Kimi K3 is a 2.8T parameter open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Moonshot AI. It is suited for complex coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon agentic workflows.

model_spec.name: Qwen 2.5 7B
model_spec.description: Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A compact model with strong coding, math, and multilingual capabilities supporting 29+ languages, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

model_spec.name: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B
model_spec.description: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A multimodal model unifying text generation with visual understanding for images, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B FP8
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B FP8 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A fast mixture-of-experts model with ~3B active parameters per token. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated
model_spec.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A text-only reasoning and coding model with refusal behavior removed and a 1M-token context window. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
model_spec.description: GLM 5.3 Flash running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A fast, low-cost multimodal model with 1M context. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
model_spec.description: Qwen 3.8 27B running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A multimodal model with 262K context supporting text and image input. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: Kimi K2.6
model_spec.description: Kimi K2.6 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). MoonshotAI's multimodal model with 262K context. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

model_spec.name: Hy4 Preview
model_spec.description: Hy4 Preview is a 770B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts flagship model from the Tencent Hy team, with 49B parameters active per token and a 1M-token context window. It is post-trained for software engineering, office and data analysis, game development, and scientific research, with strong long-horizon reasoning, tool use, and agentic performance.
